item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
• Support for the ASTRO A50 X: battery, headset volume, game/voice mix (read-only), sidetone, noise gate and the base station light, in its own panel. Contributed and tested on hardware by @erik-sutton95
  • Experimental support for the A50 Gen 5, which speaks the same protocol as the A50 X; untested, reports are welcome
  • Optional on the A50 X and Gen 5: the Mac's volume keys set the headset volume, with an on-screen level indicator. Off by default, needs the Accessibility permission
  • `astrobar-cli` gains `x-status`, `x-volume` and `x-probe` for the A50 X and Gen 5
  • Nothing changes for the A50 Gen 4

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
• Battery, charge state and dock/link detection for the Astro A50 Gen 4
  • Estimated runtime on battery and estimated time to full while charging, learned from the observed rate
  • Full parametric equalizer: three slots with per-band gain, centre frequency and bandwidth
  • 15 loadable EQ presets, including the five originals from Astro Command Center and ten from The ZEFERENCE by ZaliaS
  • Mix, microphone and stream-output controls
  • Automatic updates via Sparkle
